correctness.rationale: Uniformly rotated circular gaps anchored at a sampled contact point form Dirichlet(1,...,1). Boundedness is max gap<1/2 with probability 1-n/2^(n-1). Area equals sum tan(pi Y_i). The Beta(1,n-1) marginal gives strip density (n-1)/2^(n-2) at 1/2, so t times the bounded one-gap tail tends to this divided by pi; double large gaps are O(t^{-(n-1)})=o(1/t) for n>=3. A deterministic max/sum squeeze proves joint coefficient n(n-1)/(2^(n-2)pi), hence conditional 2n(n-1)/(pi(2^(n-1)-n)). Layer-cake yields finite q-moments iff 0<q<1. Independent symbolic substitution of the prior Dirichlet general theorem at alpha=1 agrees exactly (n=3 constant 12/pi).
